Prior on measurement shifts

Source: R/observation_model_likelihoods.R
prob_shifts.Rd

Assumes measurement shifts are drawn from a normal distribution (random effects) with given standard deviation and mean. Code is commented out to assume log normally distributied

prob_shifts(rhos, pars)

Arguments

rhos

vector of measurement shifts

pars

vector of parameters, including rho_mean and rho_sd for the normal distribution

Value

a single log prior probability

See also

Other priors: calc_phi_probs(), calc_phi_probs_indiv(), calc_phi_probs_spline(), create_prob_shifts(), dbb_prior(), density_beta_binom(), find_beta_prior_mode(), find_beta_prior_with_mean(), find_beta_prior_with_mean_var(), fit_beta_prior(), fit_normal_prior(), inf_mat_prior(), infection_history_prior()
